name: MiyooCFW
notes: The ROMS partition (mmcblk0p5) mounts on /roms and is built as ext4, where folder case matters. etc/main also accepts a FAT32 ROMS partition (os board/miyoo/rootfs/etc/main:181-186).
The bundled emulator links point at /mnt/roms/<SYS> while the partition mounts on /roms. Nothing in the buildroot tree joins the two.

The image installs seven emulator packages as release .ipk files (os package/miyoo/ipk-drpocketsnes/ipk-drpocketsnes.mk:1-3 and the six beside it). Their gmenu2x links live inside those packages. Only the gpSP link is also kept in its source repository, the other folders are the ones the image ships.
BIOS sits in /mnt/.retroarch/system on the main partition, another partition than the games, so no relative path joins them.
